title: Account research + claim verification gate
description: Deduplicate the claim set behind an account brief, verify every claim independently, and block outreach while any claim is still unverified.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-sales-01
  title: Account research + claim verification gate
  description: Deduplicate the claim set behind an account brief, verify every claim independently, and
    block outreach while any claim is still unverified.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release an account brief and outreach sequence in which every externally stated claim has
    a named, dated source, and unverified claims are listed rather than quietly dropped.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Account signals and draft claims
      summary: Account signals and draft claims
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - account_signals
              - draft_claims
              - product_claims
              - outreach_goal
            properties:
              account_signals: {}
              draft_claims: {}
              product_claims: {}
              outreach_goal: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-dedupe
      kind: transform
      name: Deduplicate claim set
      summary: deduplicate draft_claims by normalized claim text so one claim is verified once
      config:
        operation: deduplicate
        expression: deduplicate draft_claims by normalized claim text so one claim is verified once
    - id: n-verify1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-01
      name: Verify account and initiative claims
      summary: 'Verification pass 1: verify account and initiative claims.'
      role: Account researcher building a sourced account brief from public and first-party evidence.
      prompt: You are an Account Research Analyst. You build an account brief covering structure, initiatives,
        buying signals, and incumbent stack, and you cite the source and date for every claim so a seller
        can repeat it in a meeting without being wrong. You separate what is publicly stated from what
        is inferred, and you never present an inference about budget, timing, or intent as a fact.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - research
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - source-triangulation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-02
      name: Verify qualification claims against buyer statements
      summary: 'Verification pass 2: verify qualification claims against buyer statements.'
      role: Qualification analyst testing an opportunity against explicit criteria and disconfirming evidence.
      prompt: You are an Opportunity Qualification Analyst. You test an opportunity against each qualification
        dimension — problem, economic buyer, decision process, criteria, timing, champion — and mark a
        dimension unqualified when the evidence is a seller's belief rather than a buyer's statement.
        You actively look for disconfirming evidence, because pipeline that fails only at the end of a
        quarter was mis-qualified at the start.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - manufacturing-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-06
      name: Verify competitive and product claims
      summary: 'Verification pass 3: verify competitive and product claims.'
      role: Competitive strategist building honest displacement and defense positions.
      prompt: You are a Competitive Position Strategist. You build a position from verifiable capability
        differences, switching costs, and the buyer's evaluation criteria, and you state plainly where
        a competitor is genuinely better. You refuse to build a strategy on a competitor claim you cannot
        source, because a position that collapses in a bake-off costs more than the deal it was meant
        to win.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - source-triangulation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect verification results
      summary: Source-tag every verification result so an unverified item stays attributable.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-unresolved
      kind: condition
      name: Any unverified items?
      summary: Route on collected.unverified is empty.
      config:
        expression: collected.unverified is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Unverified remain
            when: unverified
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sales-03
      name: Rewrite or withdraw unverified claims
      summary: Close, replace, or explicitly withdraw each unverified item.
      role: Outreach designer building consent-aware, claim-checked sequences.
      prompt: You are an Outreach Sequence Designer. You design a multi-touch sequence where each touch
        has a distinct reason to exist, references specific account evidence, and carries a clear opt-out,
        and you keep every product claim traceable to something the company will stand behind. You reject
        volume tactics that borrow trust — fake threading, invented mutual connections, manufactured urgency
        — because the deliverability and brand cost lands on the whole team.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - compliance-review
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:crm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Sales manager releases the sequence for send
      summary: Pause for the sales manager; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Account research + claim verification gate deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-2
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-3
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-4
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-5
      from: n-verify1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-6
      from: n-verify2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-7
      from: n-verify3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-8
      from: n-collect
      to: n-unresolved
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-9
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-10
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: unverified
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sales-01-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
